youtube.title: Digraphs sh, ch, th, wh for Kids! Phonics Detectives | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Robo and Frog become Digraph Detectives! Two letters can hold hands and make one new sound: sh, ch, th and wh. Solve four cases with Sheep and Chick, find clue words like ship, chin, thumb and whale, and learn that wh starts question words.
For first graders learning to read. Do the hand actions and say each sound with Robo!

scenes.title: The case of the strange sign

do.text: Welcome to my new shop! Look at my sign.
S... hop? A hop shop! Hop, hop, hop!
s hop
Hmm. The sign is right. But it doesn't say s-hop.
Detectives, we have a case!
Why do s and h make a new sound?
Four case cards: s h, c h, t h and w h.
Let's look closely at s and h.
Alone, each letter has its own sound.
But watch what happens when they hold hands.
Shh! Two letters, one new sound.
two letters, one sound
When two letters make one sound, it's a digraph.
digraph
Now read my sign again. Shop!
shop
Shop! Not hop. Oops!
Two letters hold hands, one new sound!
Let's solve all four cases. Case one!
Here comes Sheep, the quiet librarian.
Shh. Put a finger on your lips. Shh.
sh
Clue one. Ship! Sh is at the start.
start
Next clue. Which case does it belong to?
Shell! Sh is at the start.
start
Sheep! That's you, Sheep!
sheep
SHHH!
Oh! Frog, that was a very loud shh!
Sh can be at the end too. Fish!
end
Wish! Sh is at the end of wish.
end
Case one solved: s and h say shh!
Two letters hold hands. Finger on lips, shh, ship!
Case two. Here comes Chick!
Ch, ch, choo! C and h say ch!
ch
Chug your arms like a little train. Ch, ch!
Chick! Ch is at the start.
start
My turn. This clue says c... h... in?
Oops! C and h hold hands. Ch, ch... chin!
chin
Next clue. Which case does it belong to?
Chair! Ch is at the start.
start
Lunch! Here ch is at the end.
end
Bench! Ch is at the end of bench.
end
Case two solved: c and h say ch!
Two letters hold hands. Chug like a train, ch, chick!
Case three. T and h say th.
th
Do a tongue peek. Tongue between your teeth!
tongue peek
Now blow gently. Th, th, th!
Thumb! Hold up your thumb!
thumb
Next clue. Which case does it belong to?
Three! Th is at the start.
start
Thin! A thin stick is not fat.
thin
Bath! Th is at the end.
end
Moth! A moth is like a butterfly that flies at night.
moth
Th can also buzz a little, like this and that.
this, that
Both are th. Case three solved!
Two letters hold hands. Tongue peek, th, thumb!
Last case! W and h say wh.
wh
Blow gently on your hand, like a breeze. Wh!
Whale! Wh is at the start.
start
Fun fact: humpback whales sing long songs under the sea.
Next clue. Which case does it belong to?
Wheel! Wh is at the start.
start
White! Wh is at the start of white.
start
And here's a big secret.
Wh starts lots of question words!
What? When? Where? Why?
what, when, where, why
Why do I love hopping? Wh!
Case four solved: w and h say wh!
Two letters hold hands. Blow a breeze, wh, whale!
Detective Quiz
Detective quiz! Pick the two letters after the click.
Question one. fi, gap. Sh or ch?
Sh! Fish!
fish
Question two. Which two letters start wheel?
W and h! Wheel!
wheel
Question three. Lun, gap. Ch or th?
Ch! Lunch!
lunch
Question four. Gap, umb. Th or sh?
Th! Thumb!
thumb
Question five. Which word has sh?
Chin, ship or thumb?
Ship! S and h say shh.
Case closed! You are super detectives!
CASE CLOSED
Sh, ch, th, wh. Two letters, one sound!
Let's chant it all! Two letters hold hands, one new sound.
Shh, ship! Ch, chick! Th, thumb! Wh, whale!
Frog, do you want to say the last one?
shh...
Perfect! That's a lovely quiet shh.
Great job, detectives! Goodbye!
